caption: The drawing features a stack of four terracotta flower pots, organized one inside the other, with only the upper portions of the lower three visible beneath the topmost pot. Each pot has a reddish-brown color with irregular patches of lighter gray and white, suggesting wear or mineral deposits. The rims of the pots are scalloped, and a faint decorative linear pattern encircles the upper section of the uppermost pot. The background is a plain, off-white color with no additional objects or scenery. In the lower right corner, the name "WILLIAM SPIECKER" is written in small, capital letters.
title: Flower Pot
cluster: #19 — Ceramic Arts: Pottery, Stoneware, and Porcelain
